title: Tying opening asset balances to the ledger
summary: Tie the register to the ledger at the date you started using fixed assets.

steps.text: {title} shows what the ledger and the register hold on each asset account at the cutover. Record the opening journal, or use {add} for an opening asset that is missing, until the differences are zero.
You can also ask the assistant how the opening balances stand, or to finish them. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
